app.title: RISC-V Emulator and Linux System from Scratch
app.author: Bluestein
app.description: A lightweight RISC-V emulator that bundles a minimal Linux kernel and userspace, intended for educational and development use.
proposed_tests: Clone repo and run `make build` to create the emulator binary
Execute `./riscv-emulator` and verify a hello‑world program runs inside the VM
Measure boot time and compare against QEMU on the same host
Run a small C program that uses syscalls and check exit status
